observations.code_quote: LLM_ANALYTICS = "llm_analytics"  # background AI observability workflows; interactive requests use APP
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a new ClickHouse user type for background AI observability queries.

observations.behavior: Adds Iterator to imports, imports get_llm_analytics_rate_limiter, and adds a concurrency slot context manager and routing for LLM_ANALYTICS.
observations.posthog_connection: Reroutes queries tagged as LLM_ANALYTICS to the dedicated ClickHouse user, while other tagged queries remain on the default user.

observations.behavior: Adds a global concurrency rate limiter for LLM_ANALYTICS, with a 900s TTL and 10s retry timeout.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a global concurrency limit for background AI observability queries, shared across all teams.
